facts.fact: Ghana's Data Protection Commission, led by Executive Director Dr Arnold Kavaarpuo, said it registered 2,575 data controllers in 2026 and is adding spot checks, inspections and complaint investigations under Act 843.
The Data Protection Commission is enforcing the Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843) through spot checks, inspections, complaint investigations and registration verification.
Executive Director Dr Arnold Kavaarpuo spoke for the Data Protection Commission at a media engagement in Accra.
The Commission said it registered 2,575 data controllers in 2026 and undertook 3,483 training activities, with inspections and checks to follow.
The Data Protection Commission is enforcing the Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843) through inspections and registration checks.
Dr Arnold Kavaarpuo is Executive Director of the Data Protection Commission, which is acting under Act 843.
The Commission said it registered 2,575 data controllers in 2026 and is verifying registration status and running inspections.
